title: Microsoft Edge: expanded enforcement controls for Data Loss Prevention connectors
summary: The briefing accurately separates Microsoft's planned enforcement controls from the existing connector settings documented in Learn. The roadmap details, configuration paths and policy fields are supported; the new controls' defaults and licensing remain unstated.

claims.quote: Microsoft Edge: Expanded enforcement controls for Data Loss Prevention connectors

claims.quote: Searched: Edge expanded enforcement controls DLP connectors 579894 default licensing price download; "Edge" "DLP connectors" "licensing". Read security-connectors overview and DLP overview, Symantec, Trellix and Cisco setup; none specifies licensing for the planned controls.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Learn says existing Edge for Business connectors extend security investments at no additional cost.
claims.quote: These connectors allow Edge for Business to align with your established security protocols, extending the reach of your security investments at no additional cost.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The cited connector documentation does not specify the third-party products' licensing or charges.
claims.quote: Searched: "Edge" "DLP connectors" "licensing". Read security-connectors overview, DLP overview, Symantec setup, Trellix setup and Cisco Secure Access setup; no vendor licence requirement, SKU or charge stated there.

claims.claim: The connectors UI is at Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Microsoft Edge > Connectors.
claims.quote: Go to the Microsoft 365 admin center and sign in. ... In the main left navigation bar, go to Settings > Microsoft Edge. ... Navigate to the Connectors tab.

claims.claim: OnFileAttachedEnterpriseConnector supports Group Policy or registry configuration with service_provider, enable and disable fields for uploads.
claims.quote: GP unique name: OnFileAttachedEnterpriseConnector ... Registry settings ... Value name: OnFileAttachedEnterpriseConnector ... url_list, tags, enable, disable ... service_provider Identifies the analysis service provider the configuration applies to.

claims.claim: Microsoft Edge Administrator permissions in Microsoft 365 Admin Center are a connector prerequisite.
claims.quote: Microsoft Edge Administrator permissions in Microsoft 365 Admin Center

claims.where: controls[0].note; Why it matters; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Existing connectors require configuration, including a configuration policy to assign to the connector.
claims.quote: Admins must set up a configuration policy to assign to any Connector configuration.

claims.claim: Symantec setup starts under Discover Connectors > Symantec DLP Connector > Set up.
claims.quote: Under Discover Connectors, locate the Symantec DLP Connector and select Set up.

claims.claim: Intune exposes the upload setting under policy > Configuration settings > Microsoft Edge > Configuration policy for files attached for Microsoft Edge for Business Data Loss Prevention Connectors.
claims.quote: Create or modify an existing policy ... Under the Configuration settings ... Upload: Microsoft Edge > Configuration policy for files attached for Microsoft Edge for Business Data Loss Prevention Connectors

claims.claim: The upload policy supports block_until_verdict and default_action through Group Policy or registry configuration.
claims.quote: GP unique name: OnFileAttachedEnterpriseConnector ... Value name: OnFileAttachedEnterpriseConnector ... "block_until_verdict": 0, "default_action": "allow"

claims.claim: The paste and print configuration policies are also listed under the Microsoft Edge group in Intune Configuration settings.
claims.quote: Paste: Microsoft Edge > Configuration policy for bulk data entry for Microsoft Edge for Business Data Loss Prevention Connectors ... Print: Microsoft Edge > Configuration policy for print for Microsoft Edge for Business Data Loss Prevention Connectors

claims.claim: A dedicated admin UI setting for the roadmap's planned required bypass justification is not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Edge" "require_justification_tags" "Intune"; "Edge" "DLP" "connectors" "justification" "admin center". Read Symantec setup, connector overview and paste/upload references; existing policy field documented, but no dedicated UI for the planned control.

claims.claim: The existing paste policy OnBulkDataEntryEnterpriseConnector has a require_justification_tags field configurable through Group Policy or registry.
claims.quote: require_justification_tags Lists the analysis tags whose bypassable warnings require the user to enter a justification before proceeding. ... GP unique name: OnBulkDataEntryEnterpriseConnector ... Value name: OnBulkDataEntryEnterpriseConnector

claims.where: controls[3].ui and api; Governance controls: fourth row

claims.quote: Searched: "Edge" "connectors" "administrator-defined"; "Edge" "connector" "custom_messages"; "Edge" "DLP" "connectors" "bypass" "guidance". Read connector overview, Symantec/Trellix/Cisco setup and paste/upload/print references; no guidance setting found.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans more consistent connector enforcement across download, upload, paste and print workflows.
claims.quote: Administrators will be able to configure more consistent enforcement across download, upload, paste, and print workflows.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure and Autonomy; Scope: Who is covered
claims.claim: Enabled DLP connectors send content from selected user actions to an on-device DLP agent.
claims.quote: When enabled, Microsoft Edge sends content from specific user actions to the on-device agent and waits for the verdict before proceeding.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Edge for Business natively enforces DLP verdicts from the on-device agents.
claims.quote: Microsoft Edge for Business Data Loss Prevention Connectors enable Microsoft Edge for Business to natively enforce DLP (Data Loss Prevention) verdicts from on-device agents.

claims.claim: Setting block_until_verdict to 1 makes Edge wait for the analysis response before giving the page access to the data.
claims.quote: If set to 1, Microsoft Edge waits for a response from the analysis service before giving the page access to the data.

claims.claim: Any other integer value of block_until_verdict permits immediate page access to the data.
claims.quote: Any other integer value allows the page to access the data immediately.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: require_justification_tags identifies analysis tags whose bypassable warnings require the user to enter a justification before proceeding.
claims.quote: Lists the analysis tags whose bypassable warnings require the user to enter a justification before proceeding.

claims.claim: Omitting require_justification_tags means no justification is required by that field.
claims.quote: If omitted, no justification is required.

claims.claim: The roadmap does not say whether its planned justification control extends or replaces require_justification_tags.
claims.quote: Additional controls include required bypass justification and administrator-defined guidance.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented retention of the planned bypass explanations.
claims.quote: Searched: site:learn.microsoft.com Edge DLP enterprise connector bypass justification retained reporting administrators; "Edge" "DLP" "connectors" "justification" "retention". Read paste/upload/print policy fields and provider setup; no explanation retention stated.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance: After rollout; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented whether administrators can read the planned bypass explanations.
claims.quote: Searched: Edge DLP enterprise connector bypass justification retained reporting administrators; "Edge" "DLP" "connectors" "justification" "admin center". Read policy references, provider setup and Reporting Connectors search excerpt; no access to explanation text stated.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: Before and After rollout
claims.claim: Existing connector configuration lets administrators choose allow or block as the fallback when communication with the agent fails.
claims.quote: Choose to 'Allow file access' or 'Block file access'. This determines the default verdict if a communication error between Edge and the DLP agent occurs.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated how the new controls affect existing connector configurations.
claims.quote: Searched: Edge DLP connectors expanded enforcement download required bypass justification administrator-defined guidance default licensing; "Edge" "expanded enforcement" "default". Read roadmap, connector overview and provider setup; no migration or existing-configuration effect stated.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The roadmap describes added enforcement controls, without stating that the change expands data access or the content sent.
claims.quote: Microsoft Edge for Business is expanding its existing Data Loss Prevention Enterprise Connector capabilities. Administrators will be able to configure more consistent enforcement across download, upload, paste, and print workflows.

claims.claim: Symantec's setup instructions recommend allow for default_action.
claims.quote: Configure the following fields in the policy with the recommended values from Symantec: ... default_action | allow

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: default_action set to block denies page access to data when contacting the analysis service fails.
claims.quote: If set to block, Microsoft Edge denies page access to the data if an error occurs while contacting the analysis service.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Other default_action values, including allow, permit page access on an analysis-service communication error.
claims.quote: Any other value permits the page to access the data.

claims.claim: The documented bypass justification is text entered by the user before proceeding, rather than an administrator approval step.
claims.quote: Lists the analysis tags whose bypassable warnings require the user to enter a justification before proceeding.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope: Who is covered
claims.claim: The Symantec setup page requires end users to sign in to Edge for Business with a valid Microsoft Entra ID.
claims.quote: Ensure that end-users sign in to Microsoft Edge for Business with a valid Microsoft Entra ID.

claims.where: Scope: Not the same as Purview browser DLP
claims.claim: Edge for Business also enforces Microsoft Purview DLP policies inline in the browser.
claims.quote: Edge for Business enforces Purview DLP policies inline directly in browser, empowering organizations to safeguard sensitive data in real time.

claims.where: Scope: Not the same as Purview browser DLP; Governance controls
claims.claim: The third-party connector route uses its own connector policies rather than Purview's inline browser DLP policies.
claims.quote: You can enable the Symantec DLP Connector using Group Policy: ... Configure any combination of the following 3 settings depending on which user actions you want to be scanned by Symantec's DLP agent

claims.claim: Configuration policies can be assigned to groups, supporting the suggested group-scoped pilot once the new controls are documented.
claims.quote: Each configuration policy can be assigned to multiple Microsoft Entra groups, and a group can be assigned to multiple configuration policies.

claims.claim: The documented connector deployment check is to open edge://policy and verify that the connector policies have Status OK.
claims.quote: Navigate to edge://policy, and verify that the following policies are listed and that their Status is OK: ... OnBulkDataEntryEnterpriseConnector ... OnFileAttachedEnterpriseConnector ... OnPrintEnterpriseConnector

claims.claim: The Symantec setup page names OnPrintEnterpriseConnector as the print connector policy.
claims.quote: OnBulkDataEntryEnterpriseConnector ... OnFileAttachedEnterpriseConnector ... OnPrintEnterpriseConnector

claims.claim: Learn documents deployment of the existing three connector action policies through Group Policy or Microsoft Intune, in addition to Edge Management Service setup.
claims.quote: In addition to using the Microsoft Edge Management Service, you can now enable the Symantec DLP Connector using either Group Policy or Microsoft Intune.
